document.about: True Manufacturing T-49-HC reach-in refrigerator spec sheet (2 pages). Its dimensions are mixed numbers typeset with no space before the fraction, three ways: the font's own fraction figures in the text and the table, a numerator set smaller and raised in the drawing, and halves the font draws whole.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#151): a label ending in a colon, its value set beside it on its row, was a section title on size alone.

2026-11-24: the label's check asks only that it be no section. Since its document's leading is read from its body (p2's features are prose), `Model #:` 1.65 em below joins its paragraph; a stacked field list is #9's ground.

checks.issue: The order block's `Item #: Qty:` label was a level-6 section.
